title: Tacos al Pastor
description: Tacos al Pastor is a dish from Mexico prepared with pork shoulder, dried guajillo chilies, dried ancho chilies, achiote paste. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Al pastor-inspired pork made without a vertical spit; pineapple and chile-achiote marinade retain the intended profile.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 120 minutes.
Roast the marinated pork with pineapple until it reaches a safe temperature and caramelized edges form, then slice thin; a home oven does not recreate a vertical trompo.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 15 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Shred the fully cooked meat into thin pieces with clean forks, discarding bones and tough connective tissue.
Assemble the cooled components with the listed fillings or toppings. Refrigerate briefly if needed to set the layers.
